summary.en:
At night, Hiroshi Yagisawa and his dog Coeur, are taking a walk in Beika Street. Coeur sense something strange so Coeur is showing Yagisawa that she found the dead body in underground passageway.

Location: Underground passageway

victims.name: Eitaro Kohzuki
victims.causeOfDeath: Fell from upstairs to underground passageway
victims.causeOfDeathZh: 自楼上坠落至地下通道

suspects: Norifumi Ohga, Tamae Eguchi, and Koichi Fujiki
suspectsZh: 大贺德文、江口玉枝与藤木浩一
